title.en: Three Ledgers the Guilds Report

desc.zh: 矿业账目从登记路线开始，不会凭空造矿。后续资格检查读取真实矿工就业与矿业规模；公共审计路线还要求有岗官署。一次性登记费按本日志开启时捕获的年总收入计算。
desc.en: The mine audit starts with a recorded route, not a new mine. Later eligibility checks use actual mine employment and scale, and the audit route also requires a staffed public office. The one-time filing fee uses annual gross income captured when this journal begins.

label.zh: 公共审计：官署雇会计对账
label.en: Public audit: clerks on the public payroll

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_mine_audit = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_lan_mine_audit_chosen } set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_mine_pending_event value = 1001 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_mine_pending_event value = 1000 } } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照，按基础费率收取；另需有岗官署。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52 at the base rate; a staffed public office is also required.

consequence_note.zh: 记录审计路线；后续检查读取该选择及真实官署、矿场条件。
consequence_note.en: Records the audit route. Later checks use the recorded choice and actual office and mine conditions.

Present law, government support, people and tax sources determine full eligibility. Explicit public accounts and appeals provide a limited goal where conditions remain incomplete. title.en: Budgeting Public Obligations

desc.zh: 把申诉、当前税制和政府责任、实际复核费用落实，再核六份连续月账。共管与互助先例只免重复工作，不伪造现金。战争、失州、违约或资格丢失中断观察，明确延期后从零重数。
desc.en: Implement appeals, current taxes and government responsibility and a real review payment, then check six consecutive monthly accounts. Co-management and mutual precedents save duplicate work, never invent cash. War, loss, default or lost eligibility interrupts observation and needs explicit deferral and a fresh count.

title.en: No Blank Mandate at Succession

desc.zh: 六次公账核查通过后，由当前合格政府确认十二个月的公共委托。结案时再次核对同一试点、负责者、法律、支持与期限；条件丢失或委托到期时，留下明确的受挫或退出记录。
desc.en: After six satisfactory public accounts, the qualifying current government confirms a twelve-month commission. The close checks the same district, responsible role, law, support and expiry again. Lost conditions or an expired commission leave an explicit setback or withdrawal.
